description: This file defines the LoginFragment class for the Android application, implementing a login UI with demo authentication and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: LoginFragment
classes.description: A fragment that provides a login screen with demo authentication and notifies a listener on successful sign-in.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Called when fragment is attached to context, sets the listener if context implements the Listener interface.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Called when fragment is detached, nullifies the listener reference.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views and sets click listener for sign-in button, performs demo sign-in, updates status, and notifies listener.
